name: Doomtide

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/magic-of-faerun.  Reference entry; bespoke effects require manual resolution. Artificer is omitted where listed because that class is not available in this game.

summary: Reference-only: Create a 20-foot-radius Sphere of magical Darkness; strong wind disperses it. Appearance, entry, movement into a creature, or end of turn prompts a Wisdom save once per turn: 5d6 Psychic and subtract 1d6 from saves until the next turn ends on failure; half damage only on success. It moves 10 feet away from you at your turn start. Circle variant requires five secondary casters spending level 3+ slots and consumes three Pandemonium black pearls: range 1 mile, lasts until dispelled without Concentration; ends if any participant joins another Circle casting of Doomtide.
